question:
Two figures given on the left side of (::) are related with some logic/rule/relation. Select the missing figure on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same logic/rule/relation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86add27156ff4b375be392fb58a893821ebcfd2c88d1d5eb744ff522da602d66.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The second figure is formed by replicating the main internal geometric shape inside itself to create concentric layers, followed by placing a solid black dot directly at the absolute center.

The first pair: The first figure contains a single diamond shape. In the second figure, another smaller concentric diamond is drawn inside it, and a solid black dot is placed at the center.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a6832a797a544ecb8fac0d2c200ec3f9a980b9bb693bde427e9012cb4a26da4.png] 

The second pair: The third figure contains a single hexagon shape. Following the same rule, the missing figure must contain a smaller concentric hexagon inside the original hexagon, along with a solid black dot at the center.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
